title: Arcanadea TV Anime Casts M.A.O, Ai Kakuma
content: The staff for the television anime of Kotobukiya 's Arcanadea bishōjo plastic model series revealed two more cast members on Thursday. Both cast members (character name romanizations below are not confirmed) are reprising their roles from previous works in the franchise.
author: ANN

title: Fool Night Releases Creditless Opening Featuring Tempalay Ahead of Today's Netflix Premiere
content: FOOL NIGHT anime has released its creditless opening sequence ahead of the series’ worldwide Netflix premiere today (November 26, 2026). This is the first-ever joint project between studios SHAFT and SUNRISE, set to have a total of 12 episodes. Atsuyuki Yukawa directed the anime, which is his directorial debut.
author: Anime Corner

title: Arcanadea' Unveils Additional Cast Pair
content: The official website for a television anime adaptation of Arcanadea model series unveiled an additional cast pair on Thursday. The anime series will premiere in January 2027 on TV Asahi's NUMAnimation programming block and BS Asahi.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Supporting Cast Pair for 'Fool Night' Announced
content: The official website of the Fool Night original net anime announced a supporting cast pair on Thursday. The anime adapting Kasumi Yasuda 's sci-fi drama manga is streaming worldwide exclusively on Netflix, with all 12 episodes released simultaneously on November 26.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Main Cast for 'Monster Strike: Mera×Death - Shinigami to Boku no Ijou na Koi' Announced
content: The official website of the Monster Strike: Mera×Death - Shinigami to Boku no Ijou na Koi ( Mera×Death: The Unusual Love Between Me and the Grim Reaper ) television anime announced the main cast on Thursday. The anime series is scheduled to premiere on Tokyo MX and other stations on January 5.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Black Clover Season 2 Episode 9 Preview Images Show Yuno vs Zenon
content: Black Clover Season 2 has released preview images and synopsis for Episode 9 (Episode 179 overall) ahead of its November 30 premiere. The new season officially began on October 3, 2026 , with Crunchyroll streaming it worldwide. The anime previously revealed a special Valkyrie Dress Noelle after Episode 6.
author: Anime Corner

title: 1st Witch on the Holy Night Film Opens at #2
content: Godzilla Minus Zero , the new Godzilla sequel film from Godzilla Minus One 's Takashi Yamazaki , stayed at #1 in its third weekend in Japan, and sold 352,000 tickets to earn 589,950,800 yen (about US$3.70 million) from Friday to Sunday.
author: ANN

title: Live-Action 'Kekkon Shimashō, Koi Suru Mae ni' Series Reveals Cast, Theme Song Artists, January 2027 Streaming Debut
content: The staff for the live-action "short" series of Izumi Miyazono 's Kekkon Shimashō, Koi Suru Mae ni (Let's Get Married, Before We Fall in Love) manga announced its cast, theme song artists, and January 2027 streaming debut on Wednesday.
author: ANN

title: Nioh 3 Game Streams First Look Trailer for New DLC
content: Koei Tecmo and Team Ninja presented a first look trailer for Nioh 3 , the latest entry in the Nioh franchise, to preview the content in the Bloody Insurrection DLC volume 2 on Tuesday. The new DLC launches on December 17.
author: ANN
